FULL TEXT:
Central Animal House
PANJAB UNIVERSITY, CHANDIGARH - 160014 (INDIA).
Ref. No. 44/CAH/24 Dated: 12/02/2024
Applications along with attested copies of certificates are invited for walk-in-interview on 28/02/2024 at
11 A.M. in the committee room, Department of Biochemistry, BMS Block-II, Sector-25, Panjab
University Chandigarh for the post of Part Time Visiting Veterinary Officer in Central Animal House,
Panjab University Chandigarh. Application shall reach the office of Coordinator, Central Animal House, Panjab
University, Chandigarh by 5 P.M. on or before 26/02/2024.
Sr. Name of Post Qualification Salary Duty Hours
1. Part time visiting veterinary officer BVSC&AH Rs. 25000/- 4 Hrs daily (Monday to
Saturday)
Terms and conditions:
1. Duty hours are adjustable as per the needs of the central Animal House.
2. 20 days casual leave is available for the service put in for 12 months during the calendar year on
proportionate basis.
3. The selected candidate duly approved by the Vice Chancellor shall be required to report on duty by the date
stipulated in the letter of appointment.
4. Candidate must register with the respective Veterinary Council of India.
5. All other terms and conditions as per University rules applicable to part time employees.
Sd/-
Coordinator,
Central Animal House
PU Chandigarh
